thread:
sam_cs: Kicking off the Nectar onboarding thread. Quick intro: Marco is the Nectar PM, Leah is their SRE. High-level sprint-0 (10 days) goals: 1) wire Redwood Hosted API into Nectar's ticket flow, 2) run a 10-sample benchmark for latency/cost, 3) Console walkthrough for their CSMs. Who picks up what?

marco_pm: Thanks Sam. I'll coordinate from Nectar. Weekly sync Thursdays 11am PT preferred. I'll also ask our infra lead to share webhook payload examples and staging keys by Day 2.

leah_sre: Leah (Nectar SRE) here. We require TLS webhooks and IP allowlisting; also want EU region confirmation for data residency. Happy to work with your infra folks.

tess_success: I'll draft success criteria: (a) staging end-to-end ticket flow validated, (b) CSMs complete Console runbook, (c) baseline 95th percentile latency target <400ms for the sample set. If go-live slips past Day 30, mark renewal risk and escalate.

nick_se: I'll handle integration support and initial model suggestions. Please upload 10 anonymized tickets and a sample webhook payload. I'll share a smoke-test curl snippet for their engs.

onboard-bot: Onboarding checklist: /docs/onboarding/nectar-template. Reminder: complete security questionnaire for EU data residency step.

sam_cs: Team action items: 1) marco to intro Leah + infra by EOD, 2) Nectar to share staging keys + payloads by Day 2, 3) nick to produce smoke test + model recs Day 1-3, 4) tess to draft acceptance tests Day 2, 5) sam to set up sprint board today. I'll flag legal/compliance gating now to avoid surprises.

marco_pm: Intro email sent. Also exporting 10 anonymized tickets to shared folder by EOD tomorrow.

leah_sre: I'll coordinate IP allowlist. If they want direct peering, we'll request a peering ticket; otherwise we'll accept webhook proxy. Expect 48-72h for peering review.

tess_success: Noted on EU residency. I'll confirm routing/fallback options for EU-hosted data tomorrow and post estimates if Dedicated is required.

nick_se: Sharing a small curl snippet for their engs to sanity-check the hosted API:
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"Summarize ticket: <body>"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

sam_cs: First sync scheduled Thu 11am PT. Please add blockers to the sprint board before then. Quick ask: after first 48h, can CSMs provide feedback on the Console runbook so we can iterate?

marco_pm: Yes, CSMs will join the runbook session and provide notes. Excited to get started.

(onboarding thread concluded)
